python -c "
import more_itertools as mi

# Check all functions mentioned in requirements are available
required_names = [
    'relative_seek',  # R1 - method on seekable class
    'combination_index', 'combination_with_replacement_index', 
    'permutation_index', 'product_index',  # R2
    'polynomial_eval', 'factor', 'sieve',  # R3
    'nth_combination_with_replacement', 'all_unique', 'nth_permutation', 'value_chain',  # R4
    'sum_of_squares', 'convolve', 'matmul', 'polynomial_from_roots', 'take', 'transpose',  # R5
    'iterate',  # R6
    'partial_product', 'gray_product',  # R7
    'unique_in_window', 'duplicates_everseen',  # R8
    'polynomial_derivative', 'sliding_window',  # R9
    'batched', 'numeric_range',  # R10
]

print('Checking public API availability:')
missing = []
for name in required_names:
    if hasattr(mi, name):
        print(f'  {name}: OK')
    else:
        print(f'  {name}: MISSING!')
        missing.append(name)

if missing:
    print(f'\\nMissing names: {missing}')
else:
    print('\\nAll names available!')

# Also check version
print(f'\\nVersion: {mi.__version__}')

# Check seekable has relative_seek method
print(f'seekable.relative_seek exists: {hasattr(mi.seekable, \"relative_seek\")}')
"
